domain_topics: joint and axis faults: motor overload, encoder errors, brake wear
controller issues: power supply, I/O board, safety chain
motion problems: path deviation, vibration, speed limitation

Asset.name: ABB IRC5 Controller
Asset.description: ABB IRC5 industrial robot controller paired with IRB 1200 6-axis manipulator. Handles motion control, safety, and I/O.

Component.name: Axis 1 Motor
Component.description: Main base rotation motor (J1). Highest torque joint, drives full upper-body rotation.

Component.name: Axis 1 Gearbox
Component.description: Cycloidal gearbox for joint 1, reduces motor speed and amplifies torque.

Component.name: Axis 1 Encoder
Component.description: Absolute encoder on joint 1 providing position feedback to the controller.

Component.name: Axis 1 Brake
Component.description: Electromagnetic holding brake on joint 1. Engages on power loss to prevent arm drop.

Component.name: Controller Power Supply
Component.description: Main power supply unit inside the IRC5 cabinet, converts AC to DC for drives and logic.

Component.name: Serial Measurement Board (SMB)
Component.description: Board on the manipulator that reads all axis encoders and transmits position data to the controller.

Component.name: SMB Battery
Component.description: Backup battery on the SMB that maintains absolute encoder positions when power is off.

Symptom.name: Axis 1 motor overload
Symptom.description: Controller reports motor overload or overcurrent on joint 1. Robot slows down or stops.

Symptom.name: Revolution counter not updated
Symptom.description: After power cycle the controller reports 'Revolution counter not updated' for one or more axes.

Symptom.name: Vibration during J1 movement
Symptom.description: Noticeable vibration or oscillation when axis 1 moves, especially at low speed.

Symptom.name: Arm drops when motors off
Symptom.description: Robot arm slowly drifts or drops under gravity when drives are powered off.

FailureMode.name: Gearbox wear / backlash
FailureMode.description: Cycloidal gearbox internal wear causing increased backlash and vibration.

FailureMode.name: Holding brake worn
FailureMode.description: Brake disc material degraded, insufficient holding torque to keep arm in position.

FailureMode.name: SMB battery depleted
FailureMode.description: Backup battery voltage too low to maintain encoder revolution counters during power-off.

ErrorCode.name: Error 10036: Motor overload
ErrorCode.description: The motor temperature or current has exceeded the allowed limit. Check load, cycle time, and ambient temperature.

ErrorCode.name: Error 20252: Rev counter not updated
ErrorCode.description: Revolution counter for one or more axes has not been updated. Update revolution counters or replace SMB battery.

CorrectiveAction.name: Replace gearbox
CorrectiveAction.description: Replace the cycloidal gearbox on the affected axis and recalibrate.

CorrectiveAction.name: Replace holding brake
CorrectiveAction.description: Replace the electromagnetic brake unit and verify holding torque.

CorrectiveAction.name: Replace SMB battery
CorrectiveAction.description: Replace the SMB backup battery and update revolution counters for all axes.

CorrectiveAction.name: Reduce payload / cycle time
CorrectiveAction.description: Review and reduce payload weight or increase cycle time to lower motor thermal load.
